newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil Feb 5 coffee auction 200,000 bags - bank.
newsitem.headline: Brazil Feb 5 coffee auction 200,000 bags - bank.

text.p: The Brazilian government will auction 200,000 60-kg bags of coffee stocks in its next monthly sale on February 5, said an official from Banco do Brasil which is to hold the electronic sale.
"This is the first time the government has reached its limit of 200,000 bags for a sale," the official said.
This will include the auction of 115,000 bags from Parana state, 51,702 from Sao Paulo state and 33,298 bags from Minas Gerais, according to documents sent to Banco do Brasil.
The coffee will be from the 1982/83, 1983/84 and 1986/87 harvests.
The sale, scheduled to take place at 1400 local/1600 GMT, is part of a series of monthly auctions throughout the crop year (July/June).

Earlier this month, the head of the primary commodities department of the Industry and Commerce Ministry said the auction would be for about 200,000 bags but declined to say whether the size of the auctions would be increased afterwards.
